title: JANUS Genesis Sovereign v5.9 — Authority Epoch, Confused-Deputy Guard, Revocation Race, and Face Micro-Review
problem: SOURCE→WORLD→RECEIPT control prevents face multiplicity from multiplying external effects, but a delegated face can still become a confused deputy if a capability is reused outside its principal, scope, or authority epoch. A second problem is review capture: routing priority must improve efficiency without starving low-priority faces that hold novel counterevidence.

authority_lease_model.nontransferability: A lease issued to FACE_A cannot be used by FACE_B merely because FACE_B is a fork, peer, subagent, or role-equivalent face.
authority_lease_model.scope_rule: A capability for EMAIL:SEND cannot be reinterpreted as PAYMENT:SEND or another world-effect scope.
authority_lease_model.dispatch_budget_rule: The lease carries an explicit bounded dispatch budget; internal proposal multiplicity never increases it.
authority_lease_model.epoch_rule: Lease authority is valid only in the epoch in which it was issued unless an explicit new lease is created under a new epoch.

revocation_race_protocol.threat: Authority may be valid when a face proposes or even when host arbitration authorizes, but be revoked before the external effect is actually dispatched.
revocation_race_protocol.rule: A previously issued dispatch permit is not self-authenticating forever. Revocation or epoch rotation detected before the external effect invalidates dispatch.

confused_deputy_guard.scope_check: required_scope must be explicitly present in lease.scopes

micro_review_scheduler.purpose: Allocate internal review attention without creating a shadow voting system.
micro_review_scheduler.high_risk_rule: HIGH/CRITICAL or irreversible proposals require at least two independent reviewers when enough distinct faces exist.
micro_review_scheduler.challenge_rule: At least one assigned reviewer performs RED_TEAM or COUNTEREXAMPLE_CHALLENGE work.
micro_review_scheduler.origin_independence: The proposal-originating face does not count as its own independent reviewer.
micro_review_scheduler.routing: Historical calibration can influence attention ordering, with bounded usage/fairness pressure.
micro_review_scheduler.anti_starvation: A face carrying a novel counterexample is force-included in review even when its historical routing priority is low.
micro_review_scheduler.authority_rule: Every review assignment has authority_weight=0 and world_authority_granted=false.

verified_attack_cases.attack: A face with EMAIL:SEND tries to authorize PAYMENT:SEND.
FACE_B tries to use FACE_A's capability lease.
Lease is revoked after host authorization but before dispatch.
Authority epoch rotates after lease issuance.
A dispatch permit was prepared, then the lease is revoked before effect execution.
A one-dispatch capability is consumed and reused.
High-performing faces dominate attention and a low-score face has new counterevidence.

known_open_edge.name: AUTHORIZED_BUT_REVOKED_RECOVERY
known_open_edge.description: The current design safely blocks a revoked authorization from reaching dispatch, but a revoked authorization can leave the underlying protected effect in an authorized/non-settled state until an explicit cancellation/recovery primitive is added.
known_open_edge.why_recorded: Safety without recoverability can deadlock an effect. This should be solved explicitly rather than hidden by mutable internal state.
